    Tempered restriction-angle: the linear-algebraic core #

    This file formalizes the kernel-honest heart of the proved special case of the operator-algebraic Connes Embedding attack (the tempered automorphic subcategory).

    Two ingredients:

    • gram_gap / gram_pos / gram_gap_const — the 2×2 Gram positivity bound. For the oldspace Gram [[1, x], [x̄, 1]] with off-diagonal modulus ‖x‖, the quadratic form is bounded below by (1 − ‖x‖)(‖a‖² + ‖b‖²); the residual is ‖x‖(‖a‖ − ‖b‖)² ≥ 0. This is the dimension-free bounded-right-inverse estimate underlying the tempered restriction-angle lemma.

    • deligne_ratio_lt_one / deligne_gap_pos — the Deligne temperedness bound 2√p/(p+1) < 1 for p > 1, which supplies the explicit gap constant ρ_p = 2√p/(p+1) (|λ_p| ≤ 2√p, Ramanujan–Petersson / Deligne) feeding the Gram bound.

    Together: ‖x‖ ≤ ρ_p < 1 ⇒ gram_gap_const gives a uniform (1 − ρ_p) lower bound, i.e. a dimension-free invertible Gram, the proved linear core of the tempered-subcategory HS-stability theorem.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.gram_gap (x a b : ℂ) :
    (1 - ‖x‖) * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * x).re

    The two-by-two Gram gap inequality. The proof bounds the real part by the complex norm, expands ‖a * conj b * x‖ multiplicatively, and reduces the remaining real inequality to ‖x‖ * (‖a‖ - ‖b‖)^2 ≥ 0.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.gram_pos (x a b : ℂ) (hx : ‖x‖ < 1) (hab : (a, b) ≠ (0, 0)) :
    0 < ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * x).re

    Strict positivity of the Gram form under the tempered hypothesis ‖x‖ < 1. The gap lemma gives a lower bound by (1 - ‖x‖) * (‖a‖² + ‖b‖²), and both factors are strictly positive when (a, b) is nonzero.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.gram_gap_const (x a b : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (hxρ : ‖x‖ ≤ ρ) (_hρ : ρ < 1) :
    (1 - ρ) * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * x).re

    Uniform Gram gap with a numerical radius bound. Since ‖x‖ ≤ ρ, the coefficient satisfies 1 - ρ ≤ 1 - ‖x‖; multiplying by the nonnegative norm square sum and chaining with gram_gap gives the claim.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.deligne_ratio_lt_one (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    2 * √p / (p + 1) < 1

    The Deligne restriction-angle ratio is strictly below one for p > 1.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.deligne_ratio_nonneg (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ 2 * √p / (p + 1)

    The Deligne restriction-angle ratio is nonnegative for p ≥ 0.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.deligne_gap_pos (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    0 < 1 - 2 * √p / (p + 1)

    The Deligne temperedness gap is positive for p > 1.
